notes.title: Updates regarding 3rd-party Steam key stores
notes.content:
About three years ago, I entered into a contract with a company called "Immanitas" who I think might not be legitimate anymore. For the last two quarters, they failed to furnish Sales reports for Q2, and Q3 and didn't pay me the agreed share of revenue for the last three quarters even after following up with them for multiple times. They have completely stopped responding.

Yesterday, I had contacted all of the major Steam key selling stores to de-list all of my titles published by the said company and as soon as they completely de-list the titles, I will begin the process of banning the unsold keys distributed by Immanitas only and this ban will not be retroactive. So, if you already purchased from a 3rd-party store and activated the key before, then you're fine and will be unaffected by the ban. The ban also doesn't affect you at all if you purchased from the Steam store directly.

In case you were one of the unlucky users who bought the titles from those stores before they de-listed it and in the event, I ban the keys, you can ask for a refund from the store you purchased. If they don't, you can contact me at my customer support email: help.amaxang.games@gmail.com with the Steam key you got and the store you purchased from and I will arrange a replacement key for you.

notes.title: Update #2 - Changes in Keyboard Controls
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As per the suggestions received from the Steam community, I made some changes to the keyboard controls and added new controls scheme in order to improve the player's gameplay experience.

[b]1. Now the player can jump using "Spacebar" in addition to "W" key.[/b]

[b]2. Previously, the player could shoot by pressing "Spacebar" but it has been changed to "Left Mouse Button". [/b]

The problem with using Spacebar was that you had to repeatedly press it in order to shoot the enemies but now, you just have to hold the left mouse button to shoot multiple bullets at once. The New control settings can be viewed in-game under the "Options" section of the game.

XBOX Controller controls will be modified and some bugs will be fixed and I will provide an update soon.

If you have any more suggestions or feedback to improve the game please feel free to share them here or in the discussion section and I will listen to all of you and make changes to the game accordingly.

Thank you for your continuous support! 

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Changes to Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today I have made some changes to the number of Steam achievements available for this game due to the fact that this game was called as Achievement spam game. But I have worked hard on this game and a genuine effort has been put into the game. According to the recent changes made by Valve, the number of achievements has been limited to 100 and I have decided to remove 106 achievements from the game. 

This game does not deserve to be called as Achievement spam game and I have decided to remove the idle achievements. I have put 6 months into making a good quality game which people would enjoy. I know that some people love collecting achievements but I would not put my reputation at stake for them. 

I am really sorry for the inconvenience and I hope you understand the reason behind such changes. If you have any feedback or queries, please don't hesitate to contact me. Thanks for your support. 

As a side note, from today onwards, my future projects will have achievement numbers between 10 and 90. 100 is a good number but I might someday consider it. 

Best Regards,
Anamik
